card.name: Salt or product word after drug name
card.fires_on: The word right after a generic drug name that names its salt or form, such as sodium, product, or capsule. Seen mostly after heparin, glucagon, phenytoin and levothyroxine.

modes.label: Sodium after drug
modes.description: The salt word sodium follows heparin, phenytoin or levothyroxine.
modes.example: Careful cardiac monitoring is needed during and after administering intravenous phenytoin<< sodium>> injection.

modes.label: Product or capsule after drug
modes.description: A form word such as product, products or capsule follows glucagon or lenalidomide.
modes.example: may be treated with a glucagon<< product>> for emergency use or concentrated intravenous glucose
